phrases.text: Question 1 is about the partial veto, which lets the governor approve a spending bill in part.
The 2023 Legislature approved the amendment; the 2025 Legislature approved it again.
Today, a partial veto may not make new words from single letters, or new sentences from parts of others.
The amendment would also bar using the partial veto to create or increase any tax or fee, or to authorize one.
Wisconsin's Type A Notice of Referendum does not include a cost estimate for the amendment.
Wisconsin publishes no official argument for the amendment.
Wisconsin publishes no official argument against the amendment.
A yes vote means a partial veto could not create or increase a tax or fee.
A no vote leaves the limits on the partial veto as they are today.
